findings.summary: Windows copy of DirEntryRaw::metadata_internal was not updated, so DirEntry::metadata() errors carry depth on Unix but not on Windows (confirmed by check)
Depth attached twice in from_entry and Windows from_entry_os, deepening error nesting with no change to depth() (confirmed, observable behavior unchanged)
Walkdir arm of DirEntryInner::metadata could use Error::from_walkdir to save lines
PR text doesn't say which case lacked depth, omits down-casting caveat, and uses a non-matching subject prefix
No test pins Error::depth() for the parallel walker

why: One blocking finding survives the checks: the Windows metadata_internal twin was missed, creating a platform asymmetry the PR's own change introduces; the nested double WithDepth leaves depth() unchanged, so it is a nit, and the rest is polish. The maintainers merged without changes.
